rationale: C12 supplies a concrete, nearly verbatim two-part drafting template: an operative designation conferring privileges, exemptions, and immunities under the International Organizations Immunities Act, followed by an anti-abridgment proviso concerning rights acquired by treaty or congressional action. The child adapts this machinery from multiple named organizations to the South Pacific Commission. C15 is also a very close predecessor, while C07 shares the statutory designation language but uses it in recitals for revocation rather than as the same operative structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate such Commission as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate such organizations as public international organizations entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act
shared_material.explanation: The core operative designation is nearly verbatim, with only singular/plural and entity-specific adaptation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the South Pacific Commission as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the above-named organizations as public international organizations ... within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organizations may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or Congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the distinctive anti-abridgment clause and its sequence immediately after the designation, changing only the named entity and grammatical number.
